preset.header: Choose a spot for your recipe
preset.text:
Each player has an associated color (look at their name in their video box) and a corresponding row in the center, marked by a card of the same color.

Your row has spots for you to play your recipes.

preset.header: Items are usually played on recipes
preset.text:
You cannot play multiple copies of the same item on a recipe.

Some items, like a Last Minute Cancellation, affect guests and not recipes!

preset.header: Each guest scores all your recipes
preset.text: Your score is the number displayed in the bottom-right corner of your video box.

preset.header: Are you ready to start the game?
preset.text: Once enough people click Ready, the real game will start!

You start with a "time bank" of 2 minutes to take all your turns, and you earn an additional 15 seconds every time you take your turn.

You will always have at least 30 seconds to take your turn!
